title: Minimum credit score
content: Conforming conventional loans require a minimum representative FICO credit score of 680. Applications below 680 must be referred to a human underwriter. Scores of 740+ qualify for the best pricing tier.

title: Debt-to-income (DTI) limit
content: The maximum allowable back-end DTI for a Qualified Mortgage is 43 percent. Applications with a DTI above 0.43 must be referred to an underwriter. DTI is monthly debt divided by gross monthly income.

title: Loan-to-value and PMI
content: LTV is the loan amount divided by appraised property value. When LTV exceeds 80 percent, private mortgage insurance (PMI) is required as a condition of approval. LTV at or below 80 percent does not require PMI.

title: Standard documentation requirements
content: Standard documentation includes two recent pay stubs, W-2 forms for the past two years, and two to three months of bank statements. Any missing document must be listed as an approval condition.

title: Self-employed documentation
content: Self-employed borrowers must provide two years of tax returns and a year-to-date profit and loss statement. A CPA letter confirming continued business viability strengthens the file.

title: Gift funds
content: Gift funds require a signed gift letter stating the amount, donor relationship, and that no repayment is expected. Large or unusual deposits require a written explanation and sourcing.

title: TRID disclosure timing
content: Under TRID, the Loan Estimate must be delivered within three business days of application, and the Closing Disclosure at least three business days before consummation.

title: Employment verification
content: A two-year employment history is expected and must be verified prior to closing. Gaps or a pending verification should be noted as a condition.

title: Decision matrix
content: Approve (conditional) when credit is at least 680, DTI is at most 0.43, and missing documents are listed as conditions. Add PMI as a condition when LTV exceeds 80 percent. Refer to underwriter when credit is below 680 or DTI exceeds 0.43.
